answer: Under Section 357 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (Chapter 19: OF CRIMINAL INTIMIDATION, INSULT, ANNOYANCE, DEFAMATION, ETC.), breach of contract to attend on and supply wants of helpless person. Whoever being bound by a contract to attend on or supply the wants of any person who is incapable of providing for himself, voluntarily omits to do so, shall be punished with imprisonment up to 3 months or fine or both.
